steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Aha, how many are you? Five, no, six, huh? I'm in a hurry, so just take me all at once!
In the alleys of Lungmen, Exusiai is making deliveries in her own special way, as usual.
What she doesn't know is that on a rooftop not far away, someone is watching her.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Tsk tsk, El is playful as ever, and her marksmanship continues to improve.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You think so too, right? Watching her makes me miss my gun.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Get Rhodes Island to make a gun-staff? Perish the thought... If Lemuen saw, she'd make fun of me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Besides, wouldn't that look like I'm pining for the past?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hm? I'm not that sentimental.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But it's not like I've forgotten either.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Times change, and so do people. I thought you'd know that better than anyone.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...That's true. You perceive things different from we do, huh.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I do think about it sometimes. What does change feel like when you count time by the century?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Can you find meaning in a subtle feeling at all?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I mean, you know it doesn't matter to me anyway.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Oh, so it was you, Mostima.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yith?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: G'day.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Does Emperor need me for something?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Not really. There hasn't been anything major lately. I was just passing by when I felt a familiar aura.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: And that's... Exusiai over there? I see, I see, just another day of work.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That's right. Also took the chance to take this little fella out for some fresh air and a little chat.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Ah, sounds like a good time. I'm jealous.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Same as always. No rest for the wicked.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You work too hard.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Oh, please. It's what I was made for.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: By the way, since you're here, I'd like to ask you a favor.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Let's hear it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I've got a nasty complainer here lately. Might be something wrong with the lock. I was hoping you'd take a look for me.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Ah, I thought the lock was looking a bit worn down when you gave it to me for safekeeping last Sauin. Wouldn't surprise me if there were some minor problems.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Pass it over then, I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Your other one's fine?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Sure, it's in the lock. The other one's just the key. Won't give me any issues.
Mostima pats the gray staff at her waist, then draws the brown staff out and hands it to Yith.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Old friend, we meet again.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: ...Huh, looks like it's in a bad mood indeed, and doesn't want to talk to me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It happens.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Speaking of which, Mostima, I've never asked you this before, but I'm curious - where did you get this lock and key?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It was somewhere around Kazdel before it came into my hands.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Near Kazdel, huh... That explains a lot.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Can't say I expected that.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: If you want more details, I mean, I could tell you the whole story. But I don't really feel like it.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: The whole story... Are you talking about the Liberi girl?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yeah, you've met?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Just once, last Sauin.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Pain in the ass, isn't she?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Yea...
'Bang!' Suddenly, a crossbow bolt penetrates into the space between Mostima and Yith.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: See?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Seems like she's no fan of mine.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No, she's just getting pissy at me. Any other questions?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Really dig deep there. I joined Penguin Logistics because of you and Emperor, but we haven't had any serious talks since then.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So hit me with any questions you got.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Have you considered looking for the other pieces?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: This is the only one left.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And even if it wasn't, it's not into the idea, and neither am I. Might as well leave things as they are.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You know though, if it really wasn't interested, it wouldn't have ended up like this in the first place.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: I see. That does make sense.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Much of the way we are now can be attributed to similar decisions.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Actually, I've asked it before, whether it wanted to come out.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Let me think... That's right, it was during the Rhodes Island operator test.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Umm... I guess because it seemed like an interesting place, so I wanted to show them what I could do?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Might've also been because I wanted to scare the Doctor.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: This one wouldn't cooperate, though. It felt something, I guess.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And hey, I gotta hand it to 'em, Rhodes Island is definitely interesting. You should check it out yourself, if you have the time.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Yes, if I have the time.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And when might that be?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Who knows? Keep an eye on Emperor's mood. If it sours, I might have some time on my hands.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: But meetings between people are wonderful things indeed.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: After its hibernation, it actually met a wielder so well suited to it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But if I'm being real, it's brought me way more headaches than power.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: But you don't mind, do you?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Guess I don't.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: In any case, that's enough chatting for the day.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: I'll let you know how the staff turns out.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Alright. Bye bye.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What's with the pissy face?

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: You.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm honored.

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: Who the hell was that? I know Emperor's got something crazy going on underneath, but I never knew Penguin Logistics had anyone like that.

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: You actually gave him your staff, and he seemed pretty comfortable with it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Let's say it's his area of expertise and he's trustworthy.

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: Let's say your trust and that crossbow bolt have a conversation.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Do you need an explanation? I'm an open book.

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: No thanks... 'they' obviously know what's going on, and just decided not to tell me.

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: And that means I shouldn't be hearing it from you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And that doesn't bother you at all?

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: My job is to keep my eyes on your horns. Beyond that, it's none of my business.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You don't care at all?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hey, hear me out. You volunteered to watch me, way back when, but there's a ton of stuff you have no way of knowing. And you're running yourself ragged to keep up with me. That's some serious masochism.

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: As if I need you to spell it all out.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'll say it again: what happened in Kazdel wasn't your fault.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Whether you were there or not, I would've pulled the trigger.

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: And you don't care that you've turned into this, I take it?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Bingo! See, you're getting to know me better and better.

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: And my choices are none of your business.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Sure, sure— Oh yeah, some folks from the Notarial Hall swung by yesterday, right? Another new job?

steps.name: Suffering
steps.text: Not for the time being, just a routine report. But...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh? Did they change your codename again?

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Yeah... *Sigh*.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That bad, huh? Lay it on me, I could use some cheering up.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: ...One-Armed Chainsaw Guy.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Huh... Did they just watch that shitty Lungmen flick?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: I brought it back. Ugh, I should've known better. Why didn't I bring them something artsy?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hah, hah, hah. Maybe you'll be Guns n' Roses next time.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: Better than One-Armed Chainsaw Guy.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Alright, let's go.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: I thought you were going to follow her around all day.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Do I look that bored to you?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: If you ask me, I'd say that there aren't many people in this world more bored than you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Do you really think so highly of me?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: That wasn't a compliment.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What matters is that I take it as a compliment.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Anyway, that really wasn't my plan. Just had to swing by to take a look, call it force of habit. Wouldn't be my first time doing this either, and you should know that.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: I do. That you're not proactively trying to make contact with her is a good thing in my opinion, but...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Ever since I had that little chat with her last Sauin, you've been totally fixated on it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Are you worried that I'll tell her something?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: If that was your plan, I might not be able to stop you. So I need to know how you feel about it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hmm... Fine then.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I know that look in your eyes. You're not gonna leave until I give you an answer.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: I'm glad you understand.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: Force speaks louder than reason with you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Tell me this... what's the best way to make someone stop caring about you?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: To disappear from their life.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No, not good enough. Once you've appeared, there's no way to completely disappear.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You have to wait for that person to find a new life, a new environment.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: To tell the truth, I never thought she'd come running here from Laterano.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: When Emperor told me she joined Penguin Logistics, I was quite shocked.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But you know, that whole time until Sauin, I never once spoke to her.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: As for what happened then... Just consider it part of the festivities.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: She's not going to give up looking for you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But she's not actually looking for me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's not like she had anything to do with it, at least not directly, but we all have to keep our mouths shut.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Is that something I can clue her in on? Tell me, One-Armed Chainsaw Guy.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: Please don't unironically call me that name.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: Unfortunately, it's absolutely top secret, so you cannot.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: See, I can't tell her the thing she wants to know the most, so what's the point of me showing up in her life?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Give her little hints here and there, pique her interest, and drag her into this whole mess?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: So, you want her to stop caring about you?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Isn't that what you want too?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: As I said, from an official standpoint, I'd like her to distance herself from any matters concerning you. Personally speaking though, I don't really care.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Honestly, if you were to ask me if that's really what I want, I don't think I'd say yes.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But when I let go of Laterano, cut all my ties, it was just as easy as when I raised my gun that one time. No hesitation.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: All I can say is, if something happens, just let it be.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: That is indeed the kind of person you are, and I don't like it. You don't care about loss.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Lots of people dislike that about me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But color me interested. What good comes from caring about loss?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You end up crying your eyes out over whatever you've lost and whatever you see yourself losing, and then what?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: I'm not here to talk philosophy with you. All I'll say is, if you really think that, then why did you come to watch her?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Take a guess?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: No clue. I don't suppose you're lame enough to be doing this in hopes that she'll realize you're here.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You haven't been reading sappy romance novels, have you? Go easy on that stuff.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: Grrr!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh, did Lemuen ever tell you why El is named after her? Why is her name Lemuel when the two of them are obviously not blood-related?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: She keeps her work and her home life separate.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The reason's simple. When she joined that family, El hadn't been born yet, and the parents decided it would be nice to integrate her into the family.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Though, that couple is just as joyous as El. If you told me they were just too lazy to come up with another name, I'd probably buy that.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: In any case, Lemuen might not straight up say it, but she's really grateful to those parents, deep down.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And she cared even more about her little sister Lemuel.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: So what does that have to do with anything you're doing here?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'll spell it out for you, One-Armed Chainsaw Guy.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm thinking that Lemuen would let Lemuel leave Laterano, not just because she wanted to.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: She's a discerning one. If El really got obsessed with you-know-what, I don't think she would've let her go.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It is precisely because that matter had nothing to do with El, and because finding me is not some obsession she can't give up—

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: —that she could come to Lungmen and join Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What Lemuen really wants is for El to see the world and find her own life.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And she kind of indirectly handed the responsibility to look after El over to me.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: Even though you left without saying goodbye?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Precisely because I left without saying goodbye.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: Watching her from a distance probably doesn't count as 'looking after.'

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's not like I left Penguin Logistics because of her either. It's something I should've done from the beginning, right?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: So you're doing all this because you believe it's what Lemuen wants you to do?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Who knows.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Might've just been an excuse I came up with to explain why I'm doing this.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: Well that's a surprise. I never expected you to come up with such a sentimental excuse.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm not a robot. There just happens to be a whole lot of stuff I don't care about.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Guilt, nostalgia, sorrow, etcetera etcetera. My heart's packed full of 'em all, but I've got them smoothed out pretty good now.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But if you or Lemuen decided to cut ties with me or something, I'd feel pretty sad.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: For how long?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Dunno, I could probably manage a week, yeah?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: That's a damn long time.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: From ten-thousand feet, you could say I also grew up with those sisters. Since El came here, it's only natural I'd keep an eye out for her.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: So, you plan to keep going along like this?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: More or less? She seems to be getting on just fine with her current partners.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I do think we'll meet once in a pair of blue moons, here or there, but only out of happenstance. That's good enough for you, isn't it?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: That's fair...

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: ...is what I'd like to say, though from a personal perspective, I don't think it'd be fair to her, even if I'm not qualified to say it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I guess. But ever since I became the owner of the lock and key, fairness has kind of left my vocabulary.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: If I've got a reason to talk to her, I'm not gonna dodge it. If there is something I have to tell her, I'll deliver the message in person.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But the truth is... I don't have a reason, or anything like that.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I have my mission, and this girl already found a new life in this city.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Don't you think that's actually fair, in a sense?

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: As long as you're fine with the status quo.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Alright, shoo already. If someday, by some stroke of ill fortune, she ends up getting tangled in our side's mess, we can pick up this discussion again.

steps.name: One-Armed Chainsaw Guy
steps.text: I won't let that happen.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Here's hoping.
